paragraphs.text: Of the roughly 7,000 languages spoken today, linguists estimate that around half may disappear by the end of this century. Many are spoken by only a few hundred people, most of them elderly, and children in these communities increasingly grow up speaking a national language instead.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The loss matters for more than sentimental reasons. Languages contain knowledge that is not recorded anywhere else, such as names for local plants used in medicine or words describing weather patterns specific to a region.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Recording is usually the first step. Linguists work with the last fluent speakers to create dictionaries, grammars and hours of audio, so that the language can at least be studied in the future even if no one speaks it daily.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Recordings, however, do not keep a language alive. The most successful revival programmes have focused on young children, often through language nests in which pre-school children spend their days with elderly speakers who use only the local language.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Technology offers new possibilities. Several communities have developed mobile apps and online courses, and one small language now has a keyboard for smartphones, which younger speakers use to send messages to each other.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: linguists estimate that around half may disappear by the end of this century

explanation.en: The scale: of 7,000 languages “around half may disappear” → iii. Heading vii is about origins, but the paragraph looks to the future, not the past.
explanation.kk: Ауқымы: 7,000 тілдің «around half may disappear» → iii. vii тақырыбы тілдердің шығу тегі туралы — абзац өткен туралы емес, болашақ туралы.
explanation.ru: Масштаб: из 7,000 языков «around half may disappear» → iii. Заголовок vii о происхождении языков — абзац говорит о будущем, а не о прошлом.

items.quote: Languages contain knowledge that is not recorded anywhere else

explanation.en: “Languages contain knowledge that is not recorded anywhere else” — knowledge of plants and weather could disappear with the language → i.
explanation.kk: «Languages contain knowledge that is not recorded anywhere else» — тілмен бірге өсімдік пен ауа райы туралы білім жойылуы мүмкін → i.
explanation.ru: «Languages contain knowledge that is not recorded anywhere else» — с языком может исчезнуть знание о растениях и погоде → i.

items.quote: so that the language can at least be studied in the future

explanation.en: Dictionaries, grammars and audio are made “so that the language can at least be studied in the future” → iv.
explanation.kk: Сөздік, грамматика және аудио «so that the language can at least be studied in the future» үшін жасалады → iv.
explanation.ru: Словари, грамматики и аудио создаются, «so that the language can at least be studied in the future» → iv.

items.quote: pre-school children spend their days with elderly speakers

explanation.en: After “however” comes the main point: successful programmes put young children with elderly speakers → vi. Heading iv about recordings is rejected here: “Recordings … do not keep a language alive”.
explanation.kk: «However» сөзінен кейінгі басты ой: кішкентай балалар қарт тіл иелерімен күн өткізетін бағдарламалар табысты → vi. iv тақырыбындағы жазба мұнда жоққа шығарылады: «Recordings … do not keep a language alive».
explanation.ru: После «however» главное: успешны программы, где маленькие дети проводят дни с пожилыми носителями → vi. Заголовок iv о записях здесь как раз опровергается: «Recordings … do not keep a language alive».

items.quote: Several communities have developed mobile apps and online courses

explanation.en: Apps, online courses and a smartphone keyboard are digital tools used by young speakers → ii. Translating books (viii) is not mentioned.
explanation.kk: Қосымша, онлайн курс және смартфон пернетақтасы — жастар қолданатын цифрлық құралдар → ii. Кітап аудару (viii) аталмайды.
explanation.ru: Приложения, онлайн-курсы и клавиатура для смартфонов — цифровые инструменты, которыми пользуется молодёжь → ii. Перевод книг (viii) не упоминается.

headings.text: Using digital tools to encourage use
Creating a record for the future
Young children learning from the oldest speakers
The origins of the world’s languages

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has five paragraphs, A–E. Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below. Write the correct number, i–viii.
